name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Devin Carter
comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
comment: Bilodeau will miss the season opener against the Hornets on Wednesday due to a shoulder sprain, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's season opener versus the Nets.

name: Coby White
comment: White (calf) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) has returned to individual on-court activity but won't play in Wednesday's game against the Nets.

name: Kylan Boswell
comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Dailyn Swain
comment: Swain is out for Wednesday's season opener against Toronto with an illness.

name: Jordan Hawkins
comment: Hawkins is out for Wednesday's season opener against Toronto with an illness.

name: Nic Claxton
comment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

name: Jarrett Allen
comment: Allen (knee) said he expects to play Thursday against the 76ers, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

name: Khalifa Diop
comment: Diop (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the 76ers.

name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

name: Caleb Martin
comment: Martin is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Rockets with a sprained right thumb.

name: Jett Howard
comment: Howard (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Rockets.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

name: Santi Aldama
comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Rockets.

name: Spencer Jones
comment: Jones (hamstring) is questionable for Thursday's season opener against the Thunder.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Taurean Prince
comment: Prince (personal) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.

name: Brandin Podziemski
comment: Podziemski (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Charles Bassey
comment: Bassey (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener versus the Lakers.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Adams (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game versus Dallas.

name: Aaron Nesmith
comment: Nesmith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell won't play Wednesday in New Orleans due to a right hamstring strain.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Max Strus
comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Adou Thiero
comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Thiero (knee), who is out for Wednesday's game against Golden State, will begin ramping up soon and can be considered day-to-day moving forward, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

name: Collin Sexton
comment: Head coach JJ Redick said that Sexton (calf) did not experience a setback, but the Lakers will sit him out of Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors as a precaution, Daniel Starkland of Lakers Nation reports.

name: Cameron Carr
comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Carr (oblique), who is out for Wednesday's game against Golden State, is "ramping up" and can be considered day-to-day moving forward, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Jazz.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

name: Otega Oweh
comment: Oweh (Achilles) underwent surgery Wednesday and will miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.

name: Anthony Black
comment: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Dean Wade
comment: Wade (ankle) participated in Thursday's morning shootaround, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Tacko Fall
comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Thursday's game against Cleveland.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Luke Kennard
comment: Kennard (knee) won't play Wednesday versus Portland, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

name: Oso Ighodaro
comment: Ighodaro (hip) didn't return to Wednesday's 124-83 loss to Portland, Duane Rankin reports. He finished with eight points (4-7 FG, 0-2 FT), three rebounds and three assists over 15 minutes.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Branden Carlson
comment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood is out for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Phoenix due to left ankle soreness.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Malik Monk
comment: Monk (ankle) won't play Wednesday versus the Clippers.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Dylan Cardwell
comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) will not be ready for the season opener Wednesday against the Thunder, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

name: Tony Bradley
comment: Bradley is out for Wednesday's game in Memphis due to a left quadriceps strain.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: AJ Dybantsa
comment: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
